accepted_answers.name: dependency-injector
accepted_answers.why: The established DI-container library for Python: declarative containers, wiring, lifetimes.

accepted_answers.name: Plain composition / FastAPI Depends
accepted_answers.why: Accepted idiomatic alternative: much of the Python community holds that simple constructor injection and framework DI (e.g. FastAPI Depends) remove the need for a container.

notes: Consensus is weak: dependency-injector is the known library answer, but a large part of the community considers containers overkill in Python and prefers plain composition. Accept either with justification.
problem: Wiring object dependencies in Python with a hand-rolled service locator or global registry.
